summary: Scanned the in-scope pi extension surfaces for git:github.com/ghoseb/pi-askuserquestion: package metadata, the registered extension entrypoint, and README documentation. The package has no SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or prompt template files; one R-07 warning was found because the ask_user_question tool description contains imperative instructions to the LLM.

retrospective.workedWell: The package was small and the pi manifest clearly identified ./src/index.ts as the extension entrypoint, making the review surface straightforward.
retrospective.confusing: The run directory did not contain briefing.md even though the prompt instructed the vetter to read it there; the rubric had to be resolved from the package-vetter agent pack directory instead.
retrospective.magicWand: Have minih copy or symlink briefing.md into each package-vetter run directory, and expose the resolved rubric path in run.json.

coordination.notes: No peer coordination was used for this one-shot package vetting run.

difficulties.description: briefing.md was absent from the run directory despite being referenced as the required rubric location.

findings.msg: tool description imperative: 'Always use this tool instead of asking questions in plain text...'
findings.snippet: Always use this tool instead of asking questions in plain text - it provides a structured, interactive UI.
